description: Plans a ladder, a deposit spread over up to 40 narrow one-sided ranges (rungs) of one pool, from assets the wallet already holds, and returns the unsigned transactions. Use when the wallet holds the token, the quote asset, or both; with only ETH or USDG, prefer plan_build, which buys the missing side and builds in one transaction. Not for an order at one price (plan_limit_order). Rungs under the price hold the quote and buy as it falls; rungs over it hold the token and sell as it rises; each earns the pool's swap fee when traded through. Returns: transactions[] (to, data, value in wei, gas), check (simulated, ok, failedStep, reason, ethNeeded, ethHeld), sendWithin, ifItReverts, slippagePct, rungs (the band as laid), fees (0.25% of what goes in; then 5% of the fees earned, 3.5% for a holder of 100,000 LOOM; every cut paid as USDG). Behavior: read-only on our side; nothing is signed or sent. The plan is laid out from the chain at this block and simulated from the owner; send it within check.sendWithin, and plan again rather than resend one that reverted. Costs quota units (agent_quota). Errors: refused with a reason when the band holds no rung, the pool has no money side, the amounts are zero, or the token is flagged.

amountQuote.description: How much of the quote asset to put in, as a decimal string. Builds the rungs under the price.

amountToken.description: How much of the token to put in, as a decimal string. Builds the rungs over the price.

copyOf.description: The id of a ladder on the current contract this one copies: its owner is paid 0.1% while it stays open in the same pair.

fullRange.description: One position across every price instead of a band. Never out of range, earns the least per dollar. Needs both amounts, or one with split: true; lowPct and highPct are ignored.

highPct.description: The band's top, in percent from the current price (for example 40).

lowPct.description: The band's bottom, in percent from the current price: negative for under it (for example -30).

newPool.description: From plan_open_pool's `then`: a pool being opened in the same plan, so the ladder is laid against its key and opening price. No split in it; both amounts, or one for a one-sided ladder.

owner.description: The wallet that signs, sends, and owns the ladder.

payWithEth.description: For a pool quoted in WETH: pay in plain ETH, wrapped inside the same transaction, nothing to approve. Default: whenever the wallet holds less WETH than amountQuote.

pool.description: A pool id from ladder_pools. Left out: the token's default pool.

referrer.description: The wallet that referred the owner: paid 0.1% of what goes in, out of the opening fee; kept by the contract from the owner's first ladder on.

rungs.description: How many rungs across the band, 1 to 40; default 40.

shape.description: Where the band puts the most: spot (even), curve (near the price), bidask (at the edges), hybrid (half spot, half bidask), custom (weights). Default bidask.

slippagePct.description: Room for the price to move before the transaction is mined, in percent. Left out: 2% on a calm pool, more on one that has been moving, at most 10%.

split.description: With one asset only: swap part of it for the other in the same pool and build the whole band, in one transaction.

startMarketCapUsd.description: For a token that has never traded, built in the pool plan_open_pool is opening (newPool): the market cap it opens at, the same as given there.

weights.description: shape custom only: a relative height per rung, low price to high, any scale; stretched over the rungs built.

name: plan_ladder
title: Plan a position from assets the wallet holds
